en: The postcard features a hand-colored illustration of a historic architectural building with ornate brickwork, pointed rooflines, and decorative stone details. The building is identified as the Baugewerkenschule (a building trade school) in the city of Rosswein. German-language text is present, including the name of the building and publisher. The twin-towered, highly detailed façade suggests late 19th or early 20th-century architecture.
